decision_cruda.rationale: N600-11 stopped 5-8h, so LH-04 is free. Norte trucks (66 t/h) are already saturated: 247 t in stockpile plus 59 t/h inflow exceeds what they can haul by 17:00. A Norte reserve would add nothing. Este has spare truck capacity (72 t/h vs 38 t/h inflow, 31 t stockpile). Activating RS-E569-01 (9.2 g/t, 421 t) with LH-04 costs 0.63 h travel plus 1 h activation, leaving about 5 h of loading at 35.6 t/h. About 180 t at 0.296 oz/t is roughly 50 oz. No development loader is taken, so no development cost.
